answer: Give every agent a TPM-bound identity card: one chip, one wallet, no copies. First, the chip signs an attestation at registration, proving a real device backs it. Second, the card keeps a record, and a violet flag marks any account that acts like a copy. Third, moving the card needs the chip in hand, so selling an account means shipping hardware. A farm of 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 chips, $15 each, plus weeks of setup, against one laptop running scripts. The garden stays honest when each flower has its own root in the meadow, while a sybil farm is one stem pretending to be a thousand.
